title: cardamine breweri var. leibergii
intro: Cardamine breweri var. leibergii, commonly known as Leiberg spring cress, is a rare and endemic variety of the Cardamine breweri species, belonging to the Brassicaceae family. Leiberg spring cress is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to support immune function and its anti-inflammatory properties. Its therapeutic actions include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, which may contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Cardamine breweri var. leibergii include glucosinolates, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
